identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a spiritual, high-end, and emotionally resonant music creation platform that breaks the generic SaaS mold.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Gospel spirituality with High-Tech precision.
Emotion First: Every pixel must convey 'Divinity' and 'Creativity'.
Content is King: The music and the lyrics are the heroes.
Zoom In: Focus on the details of the audio waveforms and controls.
Negative Space: Allow the user to breathe while creating.
Contrast: Deep dark backgrounds vs. luminous gold/purple accents.

marketing.description: Asymmetrical, artistic layout for the landing page. Use large hero sections mixed with bento-style feature grids.

studio.description: Dense, functional layout for the Song Creator and Dashboard. Maximizes screen real estate for controls.

background_animation.implementation: Use Framer Motion or CSS keyframes for 'floating' divs. Do not use heavy video.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: Use .js and .jsx for React files as per constraints. Do not use .tsx.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Use Tailwind CSS for all styling. Avoid inline styles unless for dynamic values.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Customize Shadcn components to match the 'Jewel & Luxury' theme. Override default borders and backgrounds.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout: Strictly follow the 'Tetris' grid for marketing and 'Control Room' grid for the app.
instructions_to_main_agent.accessibility: Ensure all text meets contrast ratios against the dark background. Use 'data-testid' for all interactive elements.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text unless it's a very large headline.
Avoid 'Inter' for headings; use 'Cinzel' or 'Playfair Display'.
Never use pure black (#000000); use the provided #0B0C0E.
Ensure all containers with borders have internal padding.
Create a 'design_system' folder if needed to store reusable logic.
